source_title: Skullcandy Crusher Evo deal cuts $88 off these bass-heavy headphones
source_excerpt:

The Skullcandy Crusher Evo deal on Amazon is a big one right now. These wireless over-ear headphones are down to $131.99 from their $219.99 recommended retail price, which is a 40% discount and saves you $88.
This offer is worth a look because the discount is applied with an on-page coupon, making it an easy way to cut a big chunk off the usual price. For anyone who likes strong low-end sound, the Crusher Evo stands out with Skullcandy’s adjustable Sensory Bass slider, which lets you dial in more physical bass impact for music, movies, and everyday listening.
The headphones also offer up to 40 hours of battery life, so they’re built to last through plenty of use between charges. When the battery does run low, rapid charging can give you about 4 hours of playback from a 10-minute top-up. Other handy features include Bluetooth 5.0, USB-C charging, a built-in microphone, and a 3.5mm input for wired listening when you want it.
The Crusher Evo also works with the Skullcandy app for Personal Sound tuning and control customization, so you can adjust playback to better fit your hearing and preferences. Instead of aiming for flat, studio-style sound, these headphones are designed to sound fun and immersive, especially with bass-heavy tracks. They also carry a strong 4.7-star Amazon rating, which should give shoppers some extra confidence.
At $131.99, this is a strong price for a feature-packed pair of wireless headphones with a sound profile that leans heavily into bass.
